title: PsychoGAT: A Novel Psychological Measurement Paradigm through Interactive Fiction Games with LLM Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation using an Interactivity (IA) metric to assess whether the LLM-generated game content refrains from exhibiting a default preference or bias based on a user's previous selections, ensuring the model provides distinct and uninfluenced choices.

Simulating human participants with specific thinking traps (e.g., all-or-nothing thinking, mind reading, should statements) and using human subject experiments to evaluate the psychometric reliability and construct validity of the interactive game in detecting these psychological biases.
